title: Fix Save Profile error and banner button functionality

requirements.summary: Fix the 'failed to update profile' error when saving profile changes in the Edit Profile modal
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping Save in the Edit Profile modal sends a valid update request to the backend actor
Profile changes (name, handle, bio, location) are persisted and reflected after saving
No 'failed to update profile' error is shown after a successful save
Error handling is graceful if the backend call genuinely fails

file_operations.description: Fix the profile save mutation handler in the Edit Profile dialog. Ensure the updateProfile mutation correctly maps form state to UserProfileInput type matching the backend interface (bio, username, name, handle, location, profilePhoto as ExternalBlob). Add proper error handling and success feedback. Verify that profile photo selection correctly uses ExternalBlob.fromBytes for uploaded images. Review the onSubmit handler to ensure all required fields are included and properly typed.

Review and fix the useUpdateProfile mutation hook. Ensure it calls actor.saveCallerUserProfile (not updateProfile) with the correct UserProfileInput structure. Verify query invalidation triggers after successful save to refresh profile data. Add detailed error logging to identify the exact failure point. Confirm the mutation properly handles ExternalBlob instances for profilePhoto and bannerImage fields.

requirements.summary: Fix the banner upload/change button so users can select and display a banner image
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the banner button opens a file picker
Selecting an image uploads and displays it as the profile banner
The banner is persisted in the backend and visible after page reload

file_operations.description: Fix the banner change button functionality in the profile header section. Implement a file input handler that opens a file picker when the banner button is clicked, reads the selected image file, converts it to ExternalBlob using ExternalBlob.fromBytes, and updates the form state with the new bannerImage. Ensure the banner preview updates immediately and the ExternalBlob instance is included in the profile update payload. Wire the banner button onClick to trigger the hidden file input. Verify the banner displays using ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() for the image src.
